name: svg-3d-design
description: Codex generates a reference image from your description, then uses it to build more detailed icons, vector graphics, 3D models, and CAD parts.

interface.longDescription: Make icons, vector graphics, 3D models, and CAD parts that look more like what you pictured. Codex generates a reference image from your description, then uses it to capture the shapes, proportions, and fine details in an editable file.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable SVG app icon for a birdwatching journal, with a matching PNG preview.
Rebuild this illustration as an editable SVG and compare the result with the reference.
Create an editable Blender scene for a ceramic desk lamp, with a rendered preview.
